teaser.abstractText: At Coffee Fellows, located directly opposite the visitor center, you can enjoy a cozy atmosphere where you can savor high-quality coffee specialties and a wide selection of snacks and sweet treats. Indulge in freshly brewed coffee, aromatic teas, and delicious bagels, sandwiches, or cakes. Whether you want to take a short break or take your drink and pastry with you, Coffee Fellows is the ideal place to relax and recharge your batteries for the rest of your journey. Coffee Fellows is a partner of Miles & More

All about oats: Creamy porridge, whether sweet or savory—topped with the most colorful, delicious ingredients. Savory oat bowls, salads, open-faced sandwiches, wraps, and sweet cakes round out the selection. What sets Haferkater apart? All ingredients are natural, with no hidden additives or artificial ingredients.

Daily Deli – a perfect blend of wholesome, balanced cuisine and pure flavor. Daily Deli offers a natural, high-quality atmosphere, whether you’re looking for a quick snack to go or a relaxing culinary break before your flight.
We prioritize fresh ingredients. Every meal at Daily Deli is handmade, allowing natural flavors and each ingredient to shine.

The Huck Bakery and Pastry Shop is a family-run business based in Frankfurt. Since 1936, it has been operated with passion and dedication by the third generation. In addition to breakfast items, we offer snacks, soups, salads, traditional Hessian dishes, and a wide variety of fresh, homemade baked goods. The seating areas are perfect for holding a meeting or enjoying a cocktail to kick off your vacation. Located directly at the entrance to Terminal 1, Hall A, Huck is the perfect meeting place. Take delicious Huck baked goods with you on your vacation, or stock up after.

Named after the founding year of the Michelin mobility company, 1889 CANTINE has a lot to offer: a monthly changing menu with seasonal touches, plus a delicious weekly menu featuring crisp poke bowls, sandwiches, and salads. Fresh, organically grown regional products are used, and everything is freshly prepared.
Inspired by Tel Aviv’s culinary diversity, NENI Deli combines Levantine and Mediterranean cuisine with tradition and innovation

Espresso House is Scandinavia’s leading coffee shop chain, known for its cozy, Nordic “living room atmosphere” and high-quality specialty coffee. The menu combines artisanal roasted coffee with traditional Swedish pastries and fresh, handmade snacks.

results.title: Hausmann's Bar (To Go) by Tim Mälzer

image.altText: Hausmann's Bar (To Go) by Tim Mälzer

teaser.abstractText: Despite the short time available, it should be an enjoyable experience with lasting memories for those in a hurry. Just a stone's throw away from the restaurant, guests can help themselves to a wide range of takeaway delicacies in the ‘house bar’. However, one or two of them may find it hard to resist the temptation to linger at the bar. As well as a wide range of snacks, bar guests can enjoy craft beer and homemade juices, smoothies and shakes, alcoholic and non-alcoholic, for every occasion. Hausmann's Bar is a partner of Miles & More

action.label: Hausmann's Bar (To Go) by Tim Mälzer

teaser.abstractText: It is impossible to say exactly how many pretzels have been devoured since the Ditsch bakery was founded. However, it is a fact that, for over 90 years, the Ditsch company's primary goal has been to delight people with its baked goods. At all Ditsch branches, the baked goods are prepared and baked fresh in front of you shortly before you eat them, so you can be sure they're absolutely fresh!

DELI BROS. combines German and international cuisine, modeled on the classic New York deli. In addition to its all-day breakfast selection, DELI BROS. impresses with its uncomplicated and delicious dishes: sausages and pasta, salads and burgers, homemade cakes and ice cream. DELI BROS. impresses with high-quality food and delicacies, wine, and champagne. Unusual accessories and books on the subject of enjoyment complete the range.

PERFECT DAY® MICRO brings the popular gastronomic concept, featuring a fine selection of coffees and freshly prepared snacks, directly to your gate. In addition to coffee from its own plantations in southern India, the coffeehouse offers a selection of snacks, soups, pastries, and healthy foods. In the evening, the focus shifts from café to bar service. Different lighting programs create the right atmosphere for each occasion. perfect day micro is a partner of Miles & More

Enjoy a break with Italian flair at Puro Gusto in Terminal 1, Level 3, Area B. Treat yourself to an aromatic espresso or creamy cappuccino and choose from a variety of freshly prepared paninis, fine pasticcinis and a wide range of antipasti. Whether you're looking for a quick bite to eat or a moment of indulgence before your flight, you'll find a wide range of Italian specialities here that you can enjoy while relaxing with a view of the apron.

If you’re hungry for a healthy or regional snack, Superfood by NATURAL has just the thing. Take a break and treat yourself to one of a long list of sustainable specialties that are prepared fresh every day, including sandwiches, wraps, sushi, summer rolls and poke bowls. Refreshing smooths and milkshakes round out the menu. Superfood is a partner of Miles & More

The Bistrot Restraunt offers a wide range of lovingly prepared dishes. Enjoy freshly baked pizza, delicious pasta or regional specialities such as Frankfurt schnitzel. The menu also features hearty burgers, crisp salads and tempting desserts. The integrated coffee bar is the perfect place to take a relaxing break and enjoy aromatic coffee specialities. There are also numerous snacks and meals available to take away for those in a hurry – perfect for enjoying on the go.

In the Bistrot Frankfurt Airport you can enjoy pizza, pasta and many other lovingly prepared dishes such as Frankfurter Schnitzel, burgers, salads and desserts are also available.
The integrated coffee bar is a starting point for small breaks. If you can't linger, you will also find many snacks to take away.

GOODMAN & FILIPPO in Terminal 1, Level 2, Area A offers exceptional food and beverages from its Italian-American deli concept for guests from all over the world. Everything is available to go or to enjoy on site, from detox salads and New York surf-and-turf burgers to focaccia, sandwiches, desserts, and breakfast items, as well as soft drinks, beers, and wines. Goodman & Filippo is a partner of Miles & More

Trib's in Hall B is the ideal place for travelers who want quick yet balanced meals. The menu features a variety of nutritious superfood bowls, freshly prepared fruit cups, and crisp salads that provide the perfect vitamin boost. The selection is rounded out with oven-fresh pizza, hearty sandwiches, wraps, and focaccia. Those looking for a treat can enjoy our tempting selection of sweet pastries, drinks, coffee, and fine chocolates. Trib's is a partner of Miles & More
teaser.teaser: Trib's in Hall B offers fast food for travelers: Healthy superfood bowls, fruit cups, salads, pizza, sandwiches, wraps and focaccias. Sweet pastries, drinks, coffee and snacks such as chocolates and potato chips round off the offer.

Wiener Feinbäckerei has always stood for artisanal perfection, living tradition, and a genuine passion for the baking trade. Our diverse range extends from hearty Wiener Krustis to a selection of the finest cakes and pastries to delicious snacks for in between meals. Whether it's a quick lunch on the go or a hearty breakfast on site, there's something for every guest.

Best Worscht in Town, located in Terminal 1, Level U1, Area A, has long been known beyond Frankfurt for its wide variety of curry sauces. It's a must-visit for currywurst lovers. Chili fans in particular will enjoy the different levels of spiciness on the "Brenn-O-Meter." The currywurst is served with either crispy French fries or fresh farmhouse bread. There is also an organic vegan version of the currywurst, making it a must-visit for all currywurst fans!

The Bar offers a wide variety of options: fresh snacks and sandwiches, crisp salads, various breakfast options, and much more. Of course, there is also a large selection of cold and hot drinks. Everything is available to take away or enjoy on site. The Bar is the ideal place for a short break and a relaxed start to your journey. The Bar is a partner of Miles & More
teaser.teaser: You will find The Bar in the Z Non-Schengen passenger area in Terminal 1.

teaser.abstractText: Spend some time in Anton & Anni's small yet charming Bavarian beer garden in Terminal 1, Level 3, Area B. Here, you can enjoy traditional German dishes such as white sausage, hearty snacks, liver sausage, and fresh sausage salad. There is also a selection of different beers to try. Surrounded by warm wood, blue-and-white décor, and bright fairy lights, you can experience authentic Bavarian coziness and hospitality — a little piece of Bavaria right at the airport. Anton & Anni is a partner of Miles & More

Spend some time in Anton & Anni's small yet charming Bavarian beer garden. Here, you can enjoy traditional German dishes such as white sausage, hearty snacks, liver sausage, and fresh sausage salad. There is also a selection of different beers to try. Surrounded by warm wood, blue-and-white décor, and bright fairy lights, you can experience authentic Bavarian coziness and hospitality — a little piece of Bavaria right at the airport. Anton & Anni is a partner of Miles & More

At the Traditional Bakery in Terminal 1, Level 2, Area A, the focus is on the craft of baking. Using the finest ingredients and tried-and-true recipes, the bakers draw on over 100 years of family tradition. Enjoy savory specialties such as truffle salami in ciabatta dough, fougasse with oilseeds, and classic poppy seed cake. Enjoy these with freshly brewed coffee made from 100% Arabica beans, various types of tea, or hot chocolate. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere and delicious baked goods for a pleasant break at the airport.

At the Traditional Bakery on Level 3 of Terminal 1, in Area Z, the focus is on the art of baking. They use the finest ingredients, tried-and-true recipes, and over 100 years of family tradition. Enjoy hearty specialties such as truffle salami in ciabatta dough, fougasse with oilseeds, and classic poppy seed cake. Freshly brewed coffee made from 100% Arabica beans, various teas, and hot chocolate are also available. You will find a cozy atmosphere and delicious baked goods here, making it an ideal place to enjoy a break at the airport.

teaser.subTitle: Family tradition for more than 100 years
teaser.abstractText: At the Heberer Traditional Bakery in Terminal 1, Level U1, Area B, the focus is on the craft of baking – using the finest ingredients, tried-and-tested recipes, and over 100 years of family tradition. Enjoy hearty specialties such as truffle salami in ciabatta dough, fougasse with oilseeds, or classic poppy seed cake. Freshly brewed coffee made from 100% Arabica beans, various teas, and hot chocolate are also available. Here you will find a cozy atmosphere and delicious baked goods for an enjoyable break at the airport.

Thong Thai is a sophisticated Thai takeaway concept with several locations in the Rhine-Main area. Thong Thai promises its guests high-quality, fresh, authentic Thai cuisine, prepared without MSG and with great dedication. The food quality and preparation standards are high. Only the finest ingredients and authentic Thai spices are used in the dishes.

Ciao Italia brings the culinary world of Italy to Frankfurt Airport, delighting travelers with a wide variety of delicacies. There is something for every taste: delicious pizzas that you can top yourself, crisp, fresh salads, and a large selection of pasta dishes. And don't overlook the desserts — enjoy authentic Italian gelato and treat yourself!

Falconi's could be Sergio Leone's dream come true, served up as Pasta and Pollo. After a lavish American-style breakfast, the focus shifts to classic Italian dishes and their American counterparts. First courses and second courses, salads, and desserts are served alongside panini and burgers. The food is served just as it is in Little Italy in the heart of Manhattan: without frills and of the highest quality.

Dedicated to Frankfurt's famous son, the Goethe Bar offers coffee, wine, beer and even champagne. Visitors are also tempted by a variety of hot and cold snacks that would have appealed to the city's prince of poets. The bar is understated yet elegant, and welcomes travellers with great warmth. The Frankfurt specialities are extremely popular, but the international dishes and breakfast options, which are available all day, are impressive too.

LITTLE ITALY offers Italian cuisine with colorful and aromatic dishes that will make you feel like you're on vacation. From crisp salads and soups to juicy meats and fresh fish, our menu takes you on a culinary journey through Italy's diverse regions. Of course, pizza and pasta are a must! Our menu is rounded out by delicious desserts, from tiramisu to panna cotta. Red and sparkling white wines, smooth beers, and fragrant Italian coffee specialties are the perfect accompaniment to your meal.

The Ritazza Café offers a wide selection of delicious snacks, fresh homemade sandwiches, pinsas, salads, and sweet treats such as muffins, croissants, and other sweets. You can also enjoy freshly prepared coffee specialties and Italian classics. Whether you want to take a short break or prefer to take food and drinks with you, travelers are welcome at Ritazza Café and can look forward to an enjoyable break.

MONDO Bar in Terminal 1, Level 1, Area B, near gate B60 delights travelers with authentic Italian specialties. Are you in the mood for an original Italian espresso? Or dolci that melt in your mouth? If so, MONDO is the perfect place for you! The stylish ambiance of an original Italian coffee bar that’s ideal for a refreshing break! MONDO Bar is a partner of Miles & More

MONDO Bar in Terminal 1, Level 2, Area C, near gate C15 offers travelers authentic Italian cuisine. Would you like to enjoy a traditional Italian espresso? Or some delicious dolci all'italiana? Then MONDO is the place for you! Here, you can experience the stylish ambiance of an authentic Italian caffè bar and enjoy yourself. Indulge in Italian coffee culture, delicious specialties, and warm hospitality — a taste of Italy at the airport! MONDO Bar is a partner of Miles & More

A large selection of brewed beers and freshly brewed coffee specialities are at the heart of the Brewgate experience. Exquisite wines and spirits, served by experienced bartenders, round off the range of drinks. The culinary offering includes a wide selection of savoury dishes, such as sausages or our Brewgate Pizza, which go perfectly with a cold beer. Brewgate combines a love of diverse beer, the art of brewing coffee, a hearty menu and live sports broadcasts in a modern gastropub setting. For fans of brewing culture, sports fans, families or group travellers.

At the KFC location in Frankfurt Airport, you'll find a delicious selection to satisfy every craving. Choose from classic buckets of crispy chicken pieces, fillet strips, or hot wings; grilled chicken products; or juicy fillet bites made from 100% chicken fillet. You'll also find tasty wraps, burgers, and popular side dishes, such as corn on the cob, mashed potatoes, fresh salads, and the famous coleslaw. It's the perfect place for a quick and enjoyable snack before continuing your journey.

Pezzo di Pane transports you to a flamingo-coloured synthesis of traditional and modern décor, inspired by the convivial decadence of 1960s Rimini. The dishes are prepared according to tried-and-tested recipes using fresh ingredients and aromatic spices. Highlights include pinsa, freshly prepared pasta, crisp salads, selected fine wines and excellent coffee specialities – all available to eat in or take away. Pezzo di Pane is a partner of Miles & More

Servus und Grüß Gott!
Welcome to the Paulaner restaurant at THE SQUAIRE, located at Frankfurt Airport.
Here, you will find delicious traditional cuisine, friendly service, and a typically Bavarian atmosphere.
Enjoy a freshly tapped Paulaner beer in one of our dining rooms and choose from our extensive menu.
We also offer delicious vegetarian and vegan delicacies for meat-free diners.

The Lucullus NERO restaurant serves traditional cucina Italian in an authentic atmosphere. The wide choice of reinterpreted Italian dishes can either be enjoyed in the cozy à la carte area with show kitchen or ordered to take away. The restaurant is like Italian life – innovative, vibrant, diverse and deliciously good! Lucullus Nero is a partner of Miles & More

Manga Sushi is a fresh, modern concept that seems to come straight from the colorful world of Japanese comics. Lovers of Japanese cuisine will find not only authentic sushi here, but also creative and surprising delicacies and refreshments, all available to take away. In addition to colorful sushi creations, manga fans can expect a selection of comics, cool gifts, and stylish accessories. Manga Sushi brings together enjoyment and Japanese pop culture in an exciting and lively way. Manga Sushi is a partner of Miles & More
The innovative bread concept developed in collaboration with Axel Schmitt

Asia Street Cooking is a modern fast-casual restaurant that brings together authentic Pan-Asian flavors from Thailand, Vietnam, China, and Korea. The menu ranges from trendy banh mi sandwiches and traditional appetizers to popular Asian classics. The efficient quick-service area makes the restaurant ideal for a diverse crowd—whether for a quick snack, takeout, or a full meal. A casual gathering spot that stands for speed, quality, and a flavorful fusion.

The Origin Bar & Eatery is a visual highlight that creates a relaxed atmosphere through its organic design and high-quality materials. At the open bar, guests can watch the bartenders as they meticulously prepare exquisite cocktails and snacks. The modern ambiance invites travelers to forget the hustle and bustle of everyday airport life and immerse themselves in a luxurious world of well-being. With masterfully crafted drinks and a delectable menu, a visit here becomes the perfect, leisurely start to an unforgettable journey.

The Sophia Loren Restaurant pays homage to the Italian icon, blending timeless glamour with authentic cuisine. Inspired by the charm of old Hollywood, the concept features sophisticated design and a warm, inviting atmosphere. The menu celebrates the essence of Italy through high-quality ingredients and passionately prepared dishes. As a sophisticated dining experience, the restaurant invites guests to immerse themselves in a world of style and beauty—a true moment of indulgence for lovers of fine Italian cuisine.

At Hermann's Restaurant, you can expect a wide selection of regional sausages, accompanied by homemade salads and fresh pretzels. You can also enjoy a freshly tapped beer – all of the highest quality. Be inspired by the special 1950s-style ambience, which combines the iconic retro butcher's style with modern design. Here you can experience how varied and delicious a snack can be and enjoy hearty specialities before you set off on your journey. Hermann's is a partner of Miles & More

Enjoy a small but exquisite selection of sauces, salads, bread rolls, and drinks to go with them. Perfect as a snack before your flight or for a quick pick-me-up—Hermann’s Mobile is your food paradise on wheels at the airport!

teaser.abstractText:
But first, coffee!
Brew'd focuses heavily on coffee and beer, developed in collaboration with premium coffee partners, and is a go-to spot for guests with a short stay. The menu evolves throughout the day, ranging from hearty breakfast items in the morning (pastries, sandwiches, etc.) to savory snacks in the afternoon (hot dogs, salad, beer...).

AMORE stands for authentic Italian cuisine with a modern twist and attention to detail—evident in the product range and stylish store design. The menu includes pasta, pizza, focaccia, and a selection of classic Italian drinks such as Negroni or Aperol Spritz for a typical aperitivo. AMORE is aimed at modern families and quality-conscious connoisseurs who value high-quality food, excellent drinks, and a special atmosphere. Discover Italian delights at AMORE.

AMORE combines authentic Italian cuisine with modern design and a passion for detail. The menu features classics like pasta, pizza, and focaccia, complemented by traditional aperitivo drinks such as Negroni or Aperol Spritz. With its stylish interior design, AMORE specifically appeals to modern families and quality-conscious food lovers. Here, high-quality food, excellent drinks, and a special ambiance come together to create a unique experience. Discover the true Italian experience and let yourself be inspired by the special atmosphere at AMORE.

London’s most famous café and lifestyle brand in Terminal 3! At EL&N London, classics are served all day long for dining in or takeout—from specialty coffees and matcha to brunch, lunch, and the famous, freshly prepared pastries. Treat yourself to a little refreshment in a stylish setting before your flight.

Discover the REWE To Go Shop at Frankfurt Airport - your round-the-clock shopping experience! Thanks to state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and camera technology, your selected products are automatically recorded and the amount is debited from your cashless payment method when you leave the store. If you wish, you can receive the receipt conveniently by e-mail. The REWE To Go Shop offers you a diverse selection of around 570 items. Whether for your lunch break or after work - enjoy fresh sandwiches and salads, refreshing drinks and coffee specialties as well as ice cream, snacks and confectionery. You will also find selected travel supplies and drugstore goods such as charging cables and toothbrushes. Visit us and experience a new way of shopping - fast, easy and always available!

Food.,” you’ll find a diverse selection of fresh sandwiches, wraps, and salads, refreshing beverages and specialty coffees, as well as ice cream, snacks, and sweets. Sold by people who treat you like an equal. In aisles where you’ll never lose your way. You’ll also find select travel essentials and drugstore items like charging cables and toothbrushes. teaser.subTitle: Natoo - Healty all the way
teaser.abstractText: "Healthy all the way" - Natoo offers a unique food selection with vegan and vegetarian high-quality ingredients from local production and the possibility of individual composition, complemented by food-lifestyle retail products in a warm store atmosphere. Travellers can enjoy the time before departure with a wide range of delicious bowls, such as the "Mother Earth" or "Namaste Bowl", and breakfast bowls, such as "Layovernight Oats" or "Espresso Oats", fresh salads, vegan yogurts, homemade iced teas, healthy berry boosts or flaxseed shots, as well as exciting lifestyle books. Natoo is a partner of Miles & More

teaser.abstractText: Hausmann's is an all-day establishment that combines a restaurant, bar, and takeaway service. Its home-cooking atmosphere and open kitchen offer honest, home-style cooking. The menu features vegan and vegetarian dishes, as well as meat products from sustainable farms. The craft beer bar offers freshly tapped beer from the Überquell brewery, and the takeaway menu features coffee specialties, freshly baked goods, and sweet and savory snacks. Hausmann's Restaurant is a partner of Miles & More

Whether you’re enjoying the cozy atmosphere of the restaurant, grabbing a quick bite at the takeout counter, or having a nightcap at the bar—Hausmann’s has the perfect recipe for every occasion.
The concept is based on traditional German home-style cooking, and with a touch of modern simplicity, this traditional culinary style becomes more accessible and even “to-go-friendly.”
For our products, we select only high-quality ingredients, carefully choosing and verifying their producers/suppliers and their origins. This ensures our guests enjoy a unique culinary experience of the highest caliber.

Flavors Steakhouse – a destination for those who want to experience prime beef, not just taste it. Indulge in premium prime beef, perfectly aged dry-aged cuts from our in-house aging cabinets, and exceptional seafood specialties. The culinary experience is complemented by a carefully curated and versatile wine selection, passionately chosen by our sommelier.

Here at the Taverne, tradition meets great taste - regional delicacies, freshly tapped beer, and sparkling apple wine from the Odenwald. The cozy restaurant in the brewery style is anything but ordinary, impressing with a relaxed atmosphere, authentic flavors, and a super friendly team. In short: the ideal spot to experience the combination of hearty treats and rustic ambiance.

The Bar is the perfect meeting place for relaxed evenings at Frankfurt Airport. Enjoy creative signature cocktails crafted by the bar team led by Head Mixologist James Vetter, with a special focus on whisky, mezcal, and rum.

Right next door, the Davidoff Lounge, the only smoking lounge at Frankfurt Airport, invites guests to unwind in a stylish atmosphere with exclusive cigars, premium whiskies, and fine cognacs.

A destination for connoisseurs, enthusiasts, and anyone looking to end the evening in a truly distinctive setting.

The Eatery kitchen & bar ist die stylische Verbindung zwischen dem Sheraton und dem Marriott Hotel am Flughafen Frankfurt. Mit direktem Zugang zu Terminal 1, der SkyLine zu den Terminals 2 und 3 und dem ICE-Fernbahnhof ist sie ein beliebter Treffpunkt für Reisende und Flughafenbesucher. In moderner Atmosphäre genießen Gäste American Street Bites, „We proudly serve Starbucks“-Kaffeespezialitäten, hausgemachte Kuchen,  herzhafte Take-Away Köstlichkeiten und Cocktails. Kurz: Der ideale Ort für eine Pause, ein Treffen oder den perfekten Start in den Tag.
